project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming Camel Connector
project.description: Generic Camel route-building and camel-reactive-streams bridging, parameterized by whatever endpoint URI an IngestionSpec declares - not a bespoke module per protocol. Deliberately depends on camel-core and camel-reactive-streams only: which protocol (camel-file, camel-kafka, camel-opensearch, or any of Camel's 300+ other components) is actually available at runtime is the CONSUMING application's own classpath decision, exactly how Camel itself is meant to be used - not something this library hardcodes per protocol. See D5/D6 in the design plan (revised after an earlier draft wrongly split file/kafka/opensearch into three separate modules, recreating the per-protocol fragmentation Camel exists to eliminate).
